decisions.bootstrap: stratified resample of problems within benchmark; 10000 resamples for confirmatory runs
decisions.calibration: clip(score, 0, 1); 15 equal-width bins; no per-condition normalization
decisions.equivalence: 90% interval inside A1 bound is negligible; otherwise PREREG holds or inconclusive
decisions.primary_auroc: response-weighted mean of per-benchmark AUROCs; pooled and per-benchmark values are secondary
decisions.r3: R3 metrics and L5 use box-compliant responses; complete-case exclusion covers R0/R1/R2/R4/R5 only
decisions.response_length: generated token count; characters are a secondary check
decisions.score: beta_v * (readout log probability - reference constant), as emitted by readout_fast.py
decisions.weighted_majority: RM@8 uses linear score sums over math_verify equivalence classes; ties by class count then first response; exp(score) is secondary

metrics.kendall_ci_method: scipy kendalltau over all solutions of 2000 stratified problem resamples, generator seed 20260924 (code/kendall_ci.py, 2026-10-08); replaces the vectorized draws, whose intervals did not bracket the point estimate

unit: problem cluster; all 8 responses for each of seeds 0, 1, 2
